translations.answer: The actionable steps are to verify that Python, Isaac Sim, PyTorch/CUDA, and Isaac Lab submissions are complete, check if LD_LIBRARY_PATH places the system CUDA library before the Isaac Sim bundled library in the Binary path, temporarily unset LD_LIBRARY_PATH in the Binary path and retry with create_empty.py for layered validation. Remote GUI issues still need separate verification.
